anyOf.description: UT1 − UTC in seconds as the engine used it, with its 1-sigma band and its source: observed or predicted by IERS, model after the table ends (TT − UTC, 69.184 s, less the ΔT model), or fallback in a receipt from an engine before 2.0.0; null before 1972.
TAI − UTC in seconds from the IERS leap-second list; listed is false after the list expires and its last value is carried.

description: How the engine read the instant, as a chart reports it. basis iers, from 1972 to the end of its UT1 table: TT is UTC plus the leap seconds and 32.184 s, and UT1 is UTC plus IERS UT1 − UTC. basis continuous-utc, after the table: TT is UTC plus 69.184 s, and UT1 comes from the ΔT model. basis delta-t, before 1972: the instant is read as UT1, and TT is UT1 plus the ΔT model.
